messages:
maya (product): Quick sync — discussing race conditions when two operators ack same fallback. Need clear timeline and idempotency.

diego (eng-platform): Proposal: decisions immutable. Second ack creates override decision referencing prior decision_id. Console shows both; newest is authoritative.

harper (sre): Also record actor and timestamp for each decision. Add metric fallback_override_total{route,operator}.

casey (ops): UX: show "Active decision: id... (overrides x)" and a small diff between policy versions. Operators need undo.

diego (eng-platform): Undo = new decision with action=rollback referencing original. All decisions immutable. We'll add X-Decision-Id header in runtime logs.

maya (product): Microcopy: "This action will create an override decision. Previous decision remains in the audit log."

casey (ops): Edge: if preview is stale (policy changed), block activate and show diff with "proceed anyway".

harper (sre): Telemetry: emit decision_outcome_total{decision_id,result,reason}. Also attach policy_version SHA to event.

diego (eng-platform): I'll open API PR for header + activation payload. deploy-bot: diego/eng-platform pushed feature/decision-overrides -> staging 2026-03-28T12:00:00Z

maya (product): Action items: diego spec + small console mock from casey + add metrics dashboard. Thanks.
